package.description: Desktop AI agent for Windows that finishes documents, spreadsheets and file work.

en-US.description: Desktop AI agent for Windows that finishes documents, spreadsheets and file work.
en-US.longDescription: MOOGH is a desktop AI agent client for Windows 10 and 11. Describe a task in plain language and it plans the steps, asks for approval, then works on your local files, folders and commands. Suited to document work, data summaries, file organisation, recurring reports and coding tasks. Open testing with pay-per-use pricing and no subscription.
